A compact [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that saw use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where it saw use by [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] pilots such as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The vehicle boasts a foldable wing to allow it to be transported by the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Republic gunships]]. Offensively, the vehicle boasts a pair of wingtip cannons mounted on rotating turrets to maximize attack potential.<ref name="Hasbro" />
